how.title: Indlela yokukhuphela
how.step1.title: Kopa ilinki
how.step1.text: Vula okuthunyelweyo kwi-app, cofa Yabelana, emva koko ukhethe Kopa ilinki.
how.step2.title: Yincamathisele apha
how.step2.text: Ncamathisela ilinki kwibhokisi engentla, emva koko ucofe Khuphela.
how.step3.title: Khetha uze ugcine
how.step3.text: Khetha ividiyo, isandi se-MP3, okanye ifoto ngomgangatho owufunayo.
platforms.title: Amaqonga axhaswayo
platforms.lead: Iividiyo, iifoto nesandi ezivela kumakhulu eewebhusayithi. Ezinye ezithandwa kakhulu:
faq.title: Imibuzo ebuzwa rhoqo
faq.a1: Ewe, isimahla ngokupheleleyo. Akufuneki ubhalise, ungene, okanye ufake app.
faq.a2: Kwi-Android nakwiikhompyutha, iifayile ziya kwifolda ethi Okukhutshelweyo. Kwi-iPhone nakwi-iPad (Safari), zigcinwa kwi-app ethi Iifayile → Okukhutshelweyo. Ukusuka apho ungazigcina kwiiFoto ngeqhosha elithi Yabelana.
faq.a3: Iseva yethu ayinakufikelela kumxholo wabucala, umxholo ofuna ukungena, okanye umxholo othintelwe ngokommandla. Qinisekisa ukuba okuthunyelweyo kuvulelekile kuwonke-wonke, emva koko uzame kwakhona.
faq.a4: Emva kokuba ilinki iqhutywe, khetha ukhetho oluthi MP3 phantsi kwesithi Isandi. Isandi sithathwa kwividiyo size siguqulelwe kwi-MP3 ye-192 kbps.
faq.a5: Sisoloko sikhetha inguqulelo engenalo uphawu lwamanzi xa ifumaneka. Ukhetho olunophawu lwamanzi lubhalwe ukuthi Uphawu lwamanzi.
faq.q6: Ngaba iifayile zam zigcinwa kwiseva yenu?
faq.a6: Hayi. Iifayile zithunyelwa ngqo zisuka kwiqonga lokuqala ziye kwisixhobo sakho, kwaye azigcinwa kwiseva yethu.
